meta.description: Makes a cap reach further out on some sides than on others, like a chanterelle that grew off-centre, and can tilt it towards its long side. The cap keeps its shape on every side, a longer side is that shape scaled up from the top of the cap.

cap.description: The rays of the caps, they bring their hinge with them

amount.description: How much further the cap reaches on its long side, as a share of the radius. The short side reaches as much less. Read for every cap, so a random node gives every cap its own.

offset.description: 1 = the cap sits off-centre, long on one side and short on the other. 0 = it is oval, long on two opposite sides

tilt.description: Tilts the cap on its stipe, in degrees: positive lifts the long side, negative lowers it. Read for every cap.
